facts.fact: Sierra Leone's regulator NatCA and Guinea signed a protocol introducing free mobile roaming between the two countries at the 15th Session of the African Council of Regulators (CAR-15), held alongside the Transform Africa 2025 Summit; the source is dated 2025-11-17 and gives no exact signing day.
facts.system: Sierra Leone-Guinea free roaming protocol (CAR-15 / Smart Africa)

systems.owner: NatCA (Sierra Leone) and Guinea's regulator, with mobile operators

systems.system: Guinea-Sierra Leone national backbone interconnection agreement (November 2024)

note: Roaming is expected only once operators activate it; the source gives no activation date, so no effect fact. The photo caption naming Guinea's ARPT head as CAR president is ambiguous and is not recorded as an office.
